name: Sign in and create a property
description: Verifies a signed-in manager can create a property and see it in the property list.
steps: Open Properties and add a property named "Sunrise Apartments" with location "Bungoma"
expected: The property list shows "Sunrise Apartments" and its saved location.

name: Create and retain rental operations records
description: Verifies the main rental records can be created and remain available after a page refresh.
steps: Add a lease connecting the tenant and unit
Add a rent payment of 12000 dated 2026-10-05
expected: The unit, tenant, lease and payment records remain visible in their respective sections after refresh.

name: Update and delete an expense
description: Verifies expense records can be edited and intentionally deleted.
setup: Create an expense for "Plumbing" with amount 5000
steps: Edit the expense amount to 4500 and save
expected: The updated amount is saved before deletion, and the deleted expense no longer appears in the expense list.

name: Reject invalid maintenance workflow
description: Verifies the maintenance form is usable on mobile and blocks an empty issue before any backend write.
steps: Open Maintenance on a mobile viewport
Choose Add maintenance and leave the Unit ID field blank
expected: A required-field message appears and no maintenance record is created.

name: Show portfolio financial snapshot
description: Verifies the dashboard aggregates persisted rent payments and expenses into a useful portfolio snapshot.
expected: Dashboard shows KSh 12,000 collected, KSh 3,000 expenses, KSh 9,000 net cash flow, and the open maintenance request.
